# infrawrench_compliance_pack_schedule (Resource)

A recurring delivery of a compliance evidence pack: the ZIP of per-control and per-source CSV and JSON files, a summary PDF and a checksummed manifest, covering the previous calendar month or quarter in the schedule's time zone.

Email attaches the ZIP. Slack posts the summary and uploads the ZIP into the message's thread (which needs the Slack app's `files:write` scope; without it the message goes out alone). Teams receives the summary and a link, because incoming webhooks cannot carry files.

At least one destination is required, and a framework can have at most 10 schedules.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "infrawrench_slack_installations" "workspace" {}

resource "infrawrench_slack_channel" "security" {
  installation_id = data.infrawrench_slack_installations.workspace.installations[0].id
  channel_id      = "C0123456789"
  channel_name    = "security"
}

# Last quarter's SOC 2 evidence pack lands with the auditors' contact and the
# security channel on the 2nd of January, April, July and October.
resource "infrawrench_compliance_pack_schedule" "soc2_quarterly" {
  framework_id      = "soc2"
  cadence           = "quarterly"
  send_day_of_month = 2
  hour              = 8
  timezone          = "Europe/London"
  email_recipients  = ["compliance@example.com"]
  slack_channel_ids = [infrawrench_slack_channel.security.id]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cadence` (String) One of `monthly`, `quarterly`. `monthly` delivers the previous calendar month every month; `quarterly` delivers the previous calendar quarter in January, April, July and October.
- `framework_id` (String) The framework whose pack is sent. One of `soc2`, `iso27001`. Changing it moves the schedule in place.
- `hour` (Number) Local hour, 0–23, in `timezone` the delivery fires at.
- `timezone` (String) IANA zone, e.g. `Europe/London`. It decides both when the delivery fires and where the covered month or quarter begins and ends. Validated server-side.

### Optional

- `email_recipients` (Set of String) Email addresses to send the pack to, at most 20. Write them in lower case: the server lowercases addresses, and a mixed-case one would never match.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Defaults to `true`. A disabled schedule keeps its settings and never fires.
- `send_day_of_month` (Number) Day of the sending month, 1–31. Defaults to `1`. A day the month doesn't have clamps to its last day, so 31 means month end everywhere.
- `slack_channel_ids` (Set of String) Stored Slack channel ids to post to, at most 20: the `id` of an `infrawrench_slack_channel`, not a Slack `C…` id.
- `teams_webhook_ids` (Set of String) Stored Teams webhook ids to post to, at most 20, from `infrawrench_msteams_webhook`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Server-assigned schedule id, which is also the import address.
- `last_error` (String) Why the last delivery failed, if it did. Cleared by every update.
- `last_sent_at` (String) When the last delivery was attempted (RFC 3339), or null if never.
- `last_status` (String) Outcome of the last delivery: `pending`, `succeeded`, `partial`, `failed` or `no_targets`. Cleared by every update.
- `next_send_at` (String) When the next delivery fires (RFC 3339); null while disabled.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Pack schedules import by their own id.
terraform import infrawrench_compliance_pack_schedule.soc2_quarterly 3a4b5c6d-7e8f-9a0b-1c2d-3e4f5a6b7c8d
```
